data.body: Recovery/RCA evidence 2026-09-09T12:25Z: confirmed direct cause was the object-store repair command on Gerrit host updating branch refs from the stale GitHub mirror: refs/heads/main was moved back to 665d1d0480 by 'fetch --prune https://github.com/navapbc/rebar.git +refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*' at 2026-09-08T06:03:29Z and again at 09:40:28Z. That left Gerrit NoteDb changes marked MERGED while their patchset revisions were no longer reachable from main. Repair: after completed EBS snapshots snap-05e22893edd5c2b57 (root) and snap-0908542d147c74b0c (data), I advanced Gerrit refs/heads/main from 154db1aadb892dd305c71e3e488c556b613ab208 to merge repair commit 611f030c19b4bf440ed1befdfe32d0b454ba16d1, preserving current main as first parent and the locally verified recovery commit f2e3cc58899a4554a0dd3d110a78accbe6c419be as second parent. Backup ref: refs/repair-backups/noolbenger-20260909T121206Z. Host verification: all 18 affected revisions are ancestors of main; git fsck --full --connectivity-only completed (dangling objects only) and printed fsck=ok. Replication start --all --wait succeeded. Gerrit and GitHub main now both resolve to 385ddee1bc02a4bddb7d6aaec0b18ee3770ec1af, a descendant of the repair. Local Mirror Guard verification from current main returned exit_code=0: replication in sync and all 100 checked MERGED revisions reachable. Scratch upload verification: Gerrit accepted WIP change 2909 after repair; it was immediately abandoned.
